assertions.title: Single discovery failure does not block others

steps.action: Code review of app/src/mqtt_client.rs publish_discovery error handling
steps.expected: Error in single entity publish does not abort loop
steps.observed: Code wraps self.publish() in if let Err(e) with warn!() log and continues. Comment states: 'Continue publishing remaining entities — single failure should not block others.' The function always returns Ok(()) regardless of individual publish failures.
